sources.minority_share_of_operating_profit: Fundamentals agent (fundamentals/run_fundamentals.py, ratios.csv). Outside shareholders' share of the operating profit of the business that REMAINS after the Foods sale = FY24 minorities' share of Group underlying net profit x Group UOP FY25 / (Group UOP FY25 - Foods perimeter UOP FY25) = 0.07929 x 10,084 / 7,484 = 10.68%. FY24 share = underlying NCI profit 587 (reported NCI continuing 609 less NCI share of non-underlying items +22) / (underlying profit to shareholders 6,816 + 587 = 7,403). Sources: Unilever FY25 Form 20-F (SEC accession 0000217410-26-000007, filed 12 Mar 2026) p.128 income statement (NCI continuing 609), p.42 non-underlying items (NCI +22), p.43 underlying EPS reconciliation (6,816), p.137 note 2 (UOP 10,084); Foods perimeter UOP EUR 2.6bn, Form 425 investor presentation (accession 0000217410-26-000027) slide 25; the perimeter excludes India Foods (Form 425 call transcript), so all of Hindustan Unilever stays. HUL check: HUL minorities 446 / HUL profit 1,167 = 38.2% in FY24 (20-F p.162 note 15B) vs 38.1% outside holding (Unilever 61.90%, p.194); HUL alone = 446 / 7,403 = 6.0% of Group underlying profit; other minorities (e.g. PT Unilever Indonesia, 85% owned, p.183) the rest. FY24 used because FY25 HUL figures are distorted by HUL's ice cream demerger (539 / 940 = 57%; EUR 199m non-cash dividend). Cross-checks: FY25 10.39%, H1 2026 9.46%. Assumptions (FLAG): minorities' share of operating profit = their share of net profit (HUL has net cash, so this slightly OVERstates); no minority profit leaves with the perimeter (minority holders of Indonesia etc. Foods do leave: slight OVERstatement).
